format: WSDC Registry Events, transfer of paper score sheets

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Transfer of judges' paper score sheet results to the computerized system must be audited by the Chief Judge and/or a scoring team approved by the Chief Judge, verified by a person other than the one inputting.

requirement: Every paper ballot version is verified against the paper original by the designated Chief Judge or a Chief-Judge-approved scoring-team member who is not the transcriber, before the round can lock, calculate, approve or publish.
interpretation_notes: Timing and the content of the audit record are not specified; the Chief Judge and approved-team designations depend on OD-06 (not built). Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
